shared_api_validation_privacy.result: Typed HTTP validation errors copy only field location and constraint message, excluding the supplied value even when validation fails on a parent object or the credential field itself
http_cases: credential has nested object instead of string

architecture.authority: Cloud retains authoritative users, sessions, grants, resources, workload identities, release and template records; configuration retains its independent original parameter, encrypted secret, master-key and audit store and rechecks authority over mTLS
architecture.transaction_order: Cloud declaration and reports validate local authority in their own transaction; remote metadata is fetched before the cloud write; the agent calls configuration release-target and immutable versions after Desired returns
architecture.runtime_proof: Actual sf-edge process reports executable SHA/build, PID/process instance, database migration, compiled rule identities and versions, fixed configuration references and the current consumer policy digest; connectors additionally compare the actual DataTransfer consumer update identity, generation and normalized public content
architecture.fixed_secrets: Owning Edge retains connector credential versions; encrypted node release cache requires exact release and envelope content plus current online credential.resolve identity authority for preparation fallback; explicit 401/403/409 is never fallback
architecture.state_preservation: Release agent retains original database, master key, explicit SF_ and OTEL_ integration settings; pending child and committed active state permit recovery after agent interruption; old actual process exit is observed before new readiness
architecture.config_removal: A new release target replaces managed configuration references, and node startup removes previously managed references absent from the new release while preserving ordinary configuration
architecture.rule_rollback: Pinned source rule revision and content digest remain fixed; each actual activation records its separate local rule revision, including supported older content
architecture.business_version: Heartbeat time, report sequence and identical runtime refresh do not change action version; target, batch, failure and intervention changes do
architecture.runtime_freshness: The actual runtime report timestamp is distinct from agent contact; the fifteen-second report freshness controls batch advancement while completed deployment history remains available
